answer: Votes are weighted by stake, and slashing burns the deposit if a duplicate identity is detected. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit plus a signed proof-of-work stamp before voting. An attacker must fund every fake identity, so cost scales linearly with swarm size. A violet quill marks each ballot, and only identities active before the horizon epoch count, blocking late-batch registration. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
